CHECK-049 complete with nonblocking corrections. Owner/predecessor code was neither read nor run. All 648 accounts were independently searched; 14,604 ledger comparisons reproduce mass/joins within 1.1e-9 kg. The 208 configurations with pinned thermal tables reproduce endpoints within 0.000492 kg and least usage within 7.2e-8. K13's 1.0/1.9/4.8 t deficits stand.

Fix 1: the “60% Vf” projection retains a 52.549% Vf mixture. Consistent density is 1800 rather than 1725.490 kg/m3; fibre mass fraction is .733333 rather than .67. At the published R30/ISA least geometry, payload becomes -4354.509 kg and fibre demand 77.130 t, 5.509% of cited capacity. Independent-thermal reoptimization still floats at usage .783530, endpoint +12.444 t; its matching original-mixture baseline is .721257/+16.242 t.

Fix 2: AlBeMet R15/ISA/old-coating “none through x8” misses a positive modulus interval [3.155175,3.733361]; the x3.3 witness carries +10.529 kg. This is hypothetical modulus, not sourced AlBeMet.

Thermal closure remains conditional: the R30 50 C edge factor is 1.017581 with owner inputs, .959664 under the specified independent boundary. Source, service, reference-modulus and provenance limitations are exact NFI rows. The sourced Be-free no-float conclusion survives. Eight nonblocking NFIs; no successor selected.
